name: s6-toast
note: A result shown only as a toast: the bench app's one button (bench/toast-app; `./gradlew benchToastApk` first, and run the bench from the repo root). A toast leaves no row, so the action's reply must carry it (toast: …). Settings' Build number used to be the toast here, but Settings ignores it while the instrumentation daemon runs the device as a monkey.
